page.overview:
Who is Captain Abidab?

Captain Abidab is a one-time character who appears in the The Super Mario Bros. Super Show! episode "20,000 Koopas Under the Sea." She is a sailor who lives in Happy Harbor, being the only human amongst several Toads to live there.

Her name is derived from Captain Ahab, the whale-hunting sea captain from the novel .
